parts.name: Wet Floor Sign
parts.desc: Every time you enchant an ally board slot, gain a counter, at 5 counters, give all _Bots_ in your hand +1/+1 and lose 4 counters.

parts.name: Empowered
parts.desc: Empowered cards can only trigger their effects if they are on an enchanted tile. As long as they are on one, their effect can activate. Once the enchant is disabled, they can't do their effect anymore.

parts.name: Mr. Screen
parts.desc: Magic: Switch: Enchant an ally slot with [[_ATK_]] or [[_HP_]] Conduit.

parts.name: ATK Conduit
parts.desc: Monsters here have +1 ATK. After a monster is summoned here, gain a counter. At 4 counters, disable this.

parts.name: HP Conduit
parts.desc: Monsters here have +1 HP. After a monster is summoned here, gain a counter. At 4 counters, disable this.

parts.name: Guardener
parts.desc: Armor. Taunt. Magic and Turn start: Switch: Give all Ally [[Plants]] or [[_Bots_]] +2 HP.

parts.name: Goosic
parts.desc: Magic: Add a copy of an ally _Bot_ (Max. EPIC) to your deck for every 2 enchanted slots on your board.

parts.name: Conveyor Belt
parts.desc: Turn end: Program (3): Summon a random {Lil' Bot} on every enchanted slot on your board and trigger their Magic.

parts.name: Heater
parts.desc: When an ally monster takes DMG from an enchantment, give it +1 ATK and draw a card. Magic: Enchant an ally slot with _The Flame_.

parts.name: Generator
parts.desc: Magic: Program (2): Enchant 2 ally slots with _Battery_.

parts.name: Battery
parts.desc: Starts with 2 counters. Turn end: If there is a monster here, spend a counter to give it +1 ATK. If this has 1 counter, spend it to give the monster here +2 ATK instead. At 0 counters, disable this.
